| Difficulty = 1
}}

{{recipe}}

'''Boilo''' is a traditional Yuletide drink of the north-eastern United States, specifically  Pennsylvania. It is a type of whiskey-based liqueur made with oranges, lemons, sugar and various different spices such as cinnamon. Recipes vary and may include nutmeg, cloves, caraway seed and aniseed.

== Ingredients == 
* 2 medium-large [[cookbook:orange|orange]]s 
* 2 [[cookbook:lemon|lemon]]s
* 1 small box (about 1½ [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 40 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[cookbook:raisin|raisin]]s
* 8 oz (220 g) [[cookbook:honey|honey]]
* 12 oz (355 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Whiskey|whiskey]] or more to taste
* ½–1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] each of any or all of these spices: [[cookbook:cinnamon|cinnamon]], [[cookbook:nutmeg|nutmeg]], [[cookbook:clove|cloves]], [[Cookbook:Caraway|caraway seed]], [[Cookbook:Anise|aniseed]]

==Procedure==
#Peel the oranges and lemons. Cut up the fruit and squeeze them into a [[Cookbook:Slow Cooker|crock pot]]. A [[Cookbook:Garlic Press|garlic press]] or [[Cookbook:Potato-ricer|potato-ricer]] works, or some kind of juicer or fruit squeezer. Put the remaining fruit pulp into the crock pot as well.
#Add the raisins, honey, and spices. Stir. Do not add whiskey yet!
#Start the crock pot, and let the mixture cook for about 2–4 hours. Stir occasionally. It's complete when the fruit pulp gets cooked down.
#[[Cookbook:Strainer|Strain]] into a pitcher. Mash down the fruit in the strainer to get all the liquid.
#Add the whiskey to the pitcher and stir. If you cook the whiskey, even for a short time, the alcohol will start to evaporate. Taste, and add more whiskey to your liking.
#Serve hot in shot glasses, espresso cups, or coffee mugs. After the first round, each individual serving can be reheated in the [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|microwave]].

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Use a whiskey that is at least 80 proof (40% alcohol).
